1449. Maximum Circular Subarray Sum

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Given an array of integers, you need to find the maximum possible sum of a subarray where the subarray can be circular. In other words, the subarray may wrap around the end of the array and start again at the beginning. A subarray is a contiguous part of an array. In this problem, you need to consider circular subarrays, which means the subarray can include elements from the end of the array followed by elements from the beginning. Your task is to find the maximum possible sum of such a subarray.
input_spec:
The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the array.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the elements of the array.
output_spec: Print a single integer representing the maximum sum of a circular subarray.
